commonPrompt: Create one finished square illustration for the Kanab Quest social-adventure game. Match the supplied canonical Sylvain-universe references: welcoming French comic-book drawing, thick slightly irregular black contours, simple flat colors, cream paper, deep teal woodwork, golden ochre and warm apricot accents, restrained printed halftone and light paper texture. Use the references for the visual language and believable botanical artisan workshop, never copy their protagonist. Draw a concrete scene with clearly readable objects, appealing perspective, natural light and a distinct composition suited to this episode. No photorealism, no generic glossy 3D, no brown wash, no pale peach panels. No people, faces, hands, body parts, character silhouettes, mannequins or placeholder avatars: the player's own character is composited separately by the app. No readable writing, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, brands, logos, watermarks, platform interfaces, counters, charts, statistics, trophies or money. Documents may have blank color blocks, pictorial sketches and plain ruled lines without glyphs. Screens may show only simple nonverbal pictorial objects. Do not imply that a choice has already been made: depict the situation and its materials, not a victory, punishment, payment or agreed contract. For playerPlacement left, reserve a clear standing area centered at x=25%, head near y=20% and feet at y=94%, with continuous perspective floor to the bottom; keep tables and other foreground objects on the right and do not obstruct this space. For playerPlacement center, reserve the same standing area centered at x=50%, with objects at the outer edges and continuous floor to the bottom. For playerPlacement none, use a rich close-up or still life with no reserved avatar space. Opaque background, square framing, complete illustration to every edge.
